run_review_feedback_for_task: run the feedback review script to view and mark feedback as reviewed for a mephisto task
review_set_feedback_as_reviewed: review the _set_feedback_as_reviewed function that marks a feedback entry as reviewed by updating agent state metadata
review_print_reviewed_feedback: review the _print_out_reviewed_feedback_elements function that displays reviewed feedback in a rich table format
review_print_unreviewed_feedback: review the _print_out_unreviewed_feedback_elements function that displays unreviewed feedback and prompts to mark as reviewed
review_feedback_review_type_enum: review the FeedbackReviewType enum that defines review choice options for yes, no, reviewed, and unreviewed
